history.rationale: reproducing test FAILS on buggy and PASSES on fixed; numerical probes are disabled (--no-probes), so the test transition is the whole of the evidence

plans.objective: Make selected sparse take-fill subtype/datetimelike/groupby tests fail on buggy and pass on fixed by reconstructing E_B/E_F (environment/deps/build) without modifying T_dev.
assumptions: The failing developer test cases are sensitive to dtype/subtype preservation in SparseArray.take with allow_fill=True and exercise the identity-take and/or -1/gap promotion paths described in PR#68469.
The root cause is triggered or exposed by a specific dependency/build combination (native_library_failure) rather than needing test-input changes.

actions.step: Check Python versions used by buggy and fixed venvs to determine whether a rebuild under the same CPython is needed.

Determine whether sparse-related compiled extensions import cleanly and whether numpy behavior matches the promotion defect in the PR; if mismatch suggests dependency drift, rebuild both revisions with the same explicit NumPy minor version that still matches the era expectations for this bug reproduction.
actions.command: cd /tmp && python -c "import numpy as np; import pandas as pd; print('numpy', np.__version__); print('pandas', pd.__version__)"

actions.step: If probe shows an incompatible NumPy (e.g., major/minor too new/old causing promotion behavior to differ), rebuild both revisions with a pinned NumPy version matching the era expectation so that buggy fails and fixed passes on the selected T_dev cases.

Run a single selected developer test case (example: test_take_fill_preserves_subtype) in buggy; confirm real assertion/test failure (not collection/import/setup) then run same case in fixed and confirm it passes.
Run the same selected developer test case in fixed and confirm it passes.

plans.success_criterion: Selected -k case in T_dev fails on /workspace/buggy (assertion/test failure) and passes on /workspace/fixed, solely due to the environment reconstruction (E_B/E_F) while keeping T_dev unchanged.
